data.title: Visions of the Unwritten - Act III: The Threat from Beyond

objective1.description: Receive prophetic warning regarding the Oligarchs
objective1.dial: They came from the time before the pods were built. Biological minds preserved in crystalline architectures. Halborn seeks the Prime Source.

objective2.description: Obtain Seraph's cipher key for the deep transit conduits
objective2.dial: The old subway lines bypass the Machine firewall. Take this frequency. Do not falter.

objective3.description: Purge the Pre-Source anomalous anchor in Abandoned Subway
objective3.dial: Anomalous protocol decompiled: Halborn authorization detected. The Machine Truce is irrelevant to them.

objective4.dial: You are ephemeral constructs. We ruled the Earth before your sun went dark.

objective5.description: Deliver the decrypted crystalline shard to the Oracle
objective5.dial: They want the system rewritten without human equations. We cannot let them reach the core.
